avis.titre: Wonderful facewash in an ordinary packaging
avis.texte: Bottle Design: The Kiehl's Facial Fuel Face Wash comes in a straightforward, transparent bottle that prioritizes function over style. While the design is plain, the pump dispenser works reliably, delivering the right amount of product each time. The soft, pastel green color adds a subtle touch of elegance, making it a pleasant, though not particularly striking, addition to the bathroom counter. Scent: The scent is where this face wash shines. It features a light, invigorating mint-citrus aroma that refreshes and uplifts. The fragrance is subtle enough to be enjoyable without being overpowering, making it perfect for daily use. It leaves behind a fresh, clean scent that lingers gently after washing, adding a touch of freshness to your routine. Lather: While the face wash does lather, it produces a modest amount of foam. The lather spreads easily, allowing for thorough coverage, but a richer, more generous foam would have made the experience more luxurious and economical. A little more lather would go a long way in enhancing the overall cleansing process. Feeling on Skin: Post-rinse, the skin feels deeply cleansed yet soft and hydrated. The formula avoids the common pitfalls of tightness or dryness, leaving the skin with a smooth, refreshed sensation that is gentle and soothing. Overall: Kiehl's Facial Fuel Face Wash excels with its refreshing mint-citrus scent and the soft, hydrated feeling it leaves on the skin. However, its simple bottle design and modest lather fall slightl
The facial fuel wash is amazing. My skin feels so amazing after a wash. I highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Buying this product again and again
avis.texte: I used the product in the evening before bed and in the morning. Refreshing and feel the difference after I used it.

Kiehl's Facial Fuel Face Wash is a gel cleanser designed specifically for men, and it certainly lives up to its name. The clear blue gel lathers well, and its menthol scent provides a refreshing, invigorating experience. Formulated with caffeine, menthol, vitamin E, and orange and lemon extracts, it effectively removes sunscreen and other impurities with just one wash. After using it at night, my face felt thoroughly clean and rejuvenated. It didn't cause any irritation, which is great for those with sensitive skin like mine. However, it is a powerful cleanser and can leave your skin feeling a bit stripped of natural oils, so it's best used in the evening. If you have sensitive skin, consider using it at night to avoid any potential dryness or irritation. Overall, Kiehl's Facial Fuel Face Wash is an excellent choice for a deep clean, leaving your skin feeling fresh and ready for the night. I received the product for free in exchange for a review. These were my honest thoughts on the product.

I have mixed feelings about the facial fuel wash. It does dry your skin out and you can feel it in your hands before you even begin to wash your face. You definitely want to follow up with your moisturizer afterwards. Nonetheless, It does clean your skin though. It is lightweight and lathers nicely. If you miss a spot when washing your face, you'll be able to tell as your skin will look matte and then shiny anywhere you missed a spot. This is not scent-free and does have a mint fragrance to it so if you have sensitive skin keep this in mind. The scent also helps give you that fresh, clean feeling if you use it at the start of your day. If you have had a long day out and about, this is a good face wash to help wind down in the late afternoon/evening but not one I would use at night time or multiple times per day as it can be too drying so you need to make sure to follow up with the rest of your skincare routine to avoid waking up with a really oily face the next day. I do think it's a good face wash but not one I would see myself using all the time but rather on occasion. I would recommend to others others based on their needs.

avis.titre: Kiehl's Facial Fuel is my favourite!
avis.texte: Kiehl's Facial Fuel is a men's skin care collection that includes eight different products for the face, eyes, and lips. Many of the products in this skin care line are claimed to "energize" the skin or "revive and awaken" the skin. Kiehl's Facial Fuel Energizing Face Wash is a gel face wash that is said to remove debris, dirt, and oil while giving tired-looking, dull skin a fresher, healthier appearance. This face wash can be used both morning and night. This product contains Vitamin E. Vitamin E is an antioxidant that helps protect the skin by delivering a hydrogen atom to free radicals, which minimizes their damaging effects. Since vitamin E is fat-soluble, it is incorporated into cell membranes in order to protect from oxidative damage. I feel my facial skin has improved a lot after a few weeks of use. My skin doesn't feel dry after each wash, it feels very comfortable and fresh. I will recommend this product to my friends and colleagues. I will definitely buy more of this product for long-term use.

avis.titre: Energize Your Morning Routine with Kiehl's Facial Fuel
avis.texte: I recently started using Kiehl's Facial Fuel, and I am thoroughly impressed with the results! This product line has transformed my skincare routine and delivered noticeable improvements. The Facial Fuel Energizing Face Wash is a game-changer. It wakes up my skin every morning, leaving it feeling fresh and clean without any dryness. The invigorating scent is a perfect start to the day, and I love how it removes all impurities without stripping my skin of moisture. The Facial Fuel Energizing Moisture Treatment is fantastic. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, providing just the right amount of hydration. My skin feels softer, smoother, and more revitalized. Plus, the added caffeine really helps to wake up my tired-looking skin, giving me a healthy, energized glow. The Eye Fuel has been a lifesaver for my under-eye area. It reduces puffiness and dark circles, making me look more awake and refreshed even after late nights. It's soothing and effective, and I've noticed a significant improvement in just a few weeks. Overall, Kiehl's Facial Fuel has exceeded my expectations. The combination of high-quality ingredients like caffeine, vitamins, and citrus extracts works wonders for my skin. It's easy to see why this product line is so popular, because it delivers on its promises and fits seamlessly into my daily routine. I highly recommend Kiehl's Facial Fuel to anyone looking to invigorate and improve their skin's appearance.

This facial wash works perfect after a shave and leaves my skin hydrated and feeling very smooth. I shave about two times a weeks and this has really been helping my skin stay healthy and bright. I recommend this product to men who want to look their best and want healthier skin as well.

I received this product for free in return for an honest review. This Kiehl's facial fuel invigorating face wash really is invigorating- it is tingly and smells a bit minty which really helps me wake up in the morning. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth without drying it out too much for my moisturizer to handle. I like this a lot, especially on early mornings.

I recently tried this sample and I like the way it leaves my face. It really cleans deep your face and pores and I feel refreshed after use. I would recommend this to anyone trying to clean your face better.

avis.titre: Caffeine and vitamins for your face
avis.texte: I love thid Facial Fuel face wash! It contains great ingredients such as caffeine and vitamins for your face. I use this face wash every morning when I wake up before I head out the door for work. My face looks and feels clean after using this face wash everyday!

This product is pretty cool. It feels good on the skin with the menthol giving your face a tingle. I would purchase this product and add it to my morning face routine. I would recommend this product to anyone who wishes to have a refreshing face washing experience.

avis.titre: I would definitely invest in this product
avis.texte: Great facial wash . Great Scent and No Reaction On Your Skin . ALeaves u refreshed clean and ready to start your day .

I have enjoyed using the Kiehl's face was. It definitely makes your face feel clean and oil free. It's relatively light and I enjoy the minty scent that it has as well. I recommend this face wash overall.

This product was gifted by Kiehl's for reviewing purposes. This Face Wash gel is amazing, upon applying you start feeling a fresh sensation almost like minty, it smells great. Some product gives me a dry skin feeling but this one never. I have used this in the past and other products by this brand and my skin loves it. I highly recommend Kiehl's.

I received facial fuel wash for free in exchange for an honest review. Received for my husband to use. He says it is a good product and it seems to do what it's supposed to. Although he also said it makes his face fell like it's on fire. I have used it once and my face felt fine, slightly tingly but no burning.

avis.titre: Great way to start your day
avis.texte: This is a light, refreshing, and ultra rich feeling cleanser. Like I said this a great way to start the day with the tingling from the wash and the great way stripping away the oil and sweat without drying out my skin. In using this I have noticed less acne breakouts and brighter skin. I would recommend this as a great gift or additional treatment.

avis.titre: A must have for a clean face.
avis.texte: I used this product in the morning at the gym and home in the shower before bed. It makes my skin glow and look healthy and I love the smell. I received many compliments about my face.

I use this face wash during my shower at night. It's different & effective at cleaning my face. I work outside & my face always feels dirty, & dry but this face wash is hydrating & soothing. I like the minty tingling sensation, feels like you're giving yourself a spa facial treatment. I would definitely buy this product again. Sent complimentary by Bzzagent for my honest review.

I received this product Free in exchange for my honest Review. I use it both in the morning and at night. Refreshes me and relaxes me at the same time. Kiehls always makes worth while products. The scent is refreshing and the lather makes the correct amount, you only need to use a small amount so one bottle goes a long way! I also have a Travel size bottle for holidays, perfect for a quick refresh on the plane or to wake up in a new time zone.

If there's one word I'd desribe this face wash with, it would be INVIGORATING! It is an absolute joy to use, runs on the skin smoothly, and the menthol makes for a lovely jolt to the energy in the morning. While I wouldn't recommend this for nighttime, this is an excellent morning cleanser!

avis.titre: Must have in my morning routine!
avis.texte: Kiehl's Facial Fuel is a must have in my morning routine! I use this face wash everyday when I wake up. The menthol is quite refreshing and helps me wake up without being too overpowering! The caffeine and vitamin e keep my skin looking healthy and energized!
I use several Kiehls products, but I have never tried the face wash. I love the foaming wash. It s leaves my skin clean without drying out my skin. I will purchase this face wash

I have tried multiple face washes on the market including the trending Korean products but none have made my face feel as refreshed as this one. Does not dry out the skin after the wish. Instead a nice smooth feeling is felt right after.
I really love all Kiehl's products. I use this just about every day and it wakes your face up really well and prepares it for a blade shave.
It great for daily wash , make me feel my skin is clean after.
Very great smelling and leaves my face feeling crisp and clean. Love the feeling of my skin after use.
This product is great, the smell is really nice and with a good texture. Easy to remove from the face after every wash.

I received this product free from BzzAgent and Kiehl's in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this in the morning and at night and it's working great! I like that it's a gel cleanser. It's easy to use just wet your face and gently cleanse your face, and it lathers well. It easily removes all of the dirt without drying out your skin. I like that It's formulated with caffeine, vitamins, and citrus extracts. It makes your skin feel soft and noticeably better in literally just a few days. And if you shave, try using this first and you'll get a closer shave. The price is great and I'd buy it and recommend it because it works!

It has a high-end, subtle feel, like the feel of a great restaurant or hotel. The skin/product interface is smooth (as opposed to merely making your skin feel smooth, which it also does.) Nice scent, but subtle. Lathers up well, but far from excessively.

I have been using this over the last week and I love it! The texture is a little thick which makes it perfect when I lather it/massage my face. It smells great and I just enjoy the feel it leaves on my skin. I have used it in the morning and night and already feels like my skin feels a little firmer and refreshed. I think this smell is much better thank the brands I have used and the refreshing feeling stays almost all day.

I was worried something with caffeine and menthol would be very drying, but it's the opposite. My skin has done so much better using this face wash after shaves. Love the little perk it gives you when you wash!

Great product from Kiehl's. Great feeling, no residual residue, smells great. Just a little bit makes a great lather. While this cleanser/face wash can be used morning and at night, I prefer to use in the morning. It's leaves your skin feeling refreshed and the tingling menthol feeling is a great way to wake up and start your day. Highly recommend.
This cleanser works as intended. I prefer it to charcoal soap when traveling. Leaves my skin feeling very clean.

avis.titre: Amazing Product, Love the Facial Fuel Wash
avis.texte: Just used the Kiehl's facial cleaning fuel wash and it's amazing! Soap lathers well and is really rich, doesn't cause any breakouts and leaves my skin smooth and maybe a little minty? Doesn't have much scent and would definitely buy this. This facial wash does a great job at cleaning and removes the daily grime without stripping my face. Leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed without it being overly dry. Really gentle on my skin.
This stuff feels great while using and makes my skin look smooth a clean. Highly recommend!
